get_metadata: get COCO panoptic metadata with thing and stuff class names, colors, and contiguous ID mappings
load_coco_panoptic_json: load COCO panoptic JSON annotations and convert category IDs to contiguous format for Detectron2
register_coco_panoptic_annos_sem_seg: register a COCO panoptic dataset with semantic segmentation annotations in Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog
register_all_coco_panoptic_annos_sem_seg: register all predefined COCO 2017 panoptic train and val splits with semantic segmentation
PREDEFINED_SPLITS_COCO_PANOPTIC: review the predefined COCO 2017 panoptic train and val split directory paths and annotation file paths
